_readme: Last crawled dates, read by hand from Search Console URL Inspection, one URL at a time.
There is no API for this here, so it is a manual capture: open URL Inspection, paste the
full URL, read the "Last crawled" line, write it below as YYYY-MM-DD.
Leave a URL null if Google reports it has never been crawled.
A URL crawled BEFORE its content last changed is stale - what ranks is not what we serve.
Recapture at each monthly SEO-02 refresh and update "captured".

indexingRequested: the date Shlomi first made a Search Console indexing request for a new URL, then any resubmission. Resubmitting does not move a URL up the crawl queue (Google's own dialog); the eight-week read in each ticket counts from the FIRST date.
